item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.changes: v2.0.0 Hybrid AI Editor Release: - Vietnamese Creator Suite: Word-level Karaoke/CapCut captions, BGM auto-ducking, beat-sync cuts, visual B-Roll FTS5 browser. - Studio Engine: Apple Vision face-tracking Auto-Reframe (16:9 to 9:16/1:1/4:5), ComfyUI Workflow Gallery + live WebSocket progress. - Ecosystem: Settings > Explore community Skills & Plugins catalog and GitHub Actions macOS CI/CD + DMG packaging.
